Is Buying Revolution Lighting Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:RVLT) Here Good Idea? Posted by mmahotstuff 21 pm
The stock of Revolution Lighting Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:RVLT) registered a decrease of 4.52% in short interest. RVLT’s total short interest was 1.77 million shares in December as published by FINRA. Its down 4.52% from 1.85M shares, reported previously. With 169,000 shares average volume, it will take short sellers 11 days to cover their RVLT’s short positions. The short interest to Revolution Lighting Technologies Inc’s float is 15.5%.
The stock decreased 3.06% or $0.0139 during the last trading session, reaching $0.4403. About 147,008 shares traded. Revolution Lighting Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:RVLT) has declined 83.99% since December 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 83.99% the S&P500.
Revolution Lighting Technologies, Inc. designs, makes, markets, and sells light emitting diode lighting solutions focusing on the industrial, commercial, and government markets in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The company has market cap of $10.38 million. The firm offers high-quality interior and exterior LED lamps and fixtures, including signage and control systems. It currently has negative earnings. The Company’s products are used for interior use, outdoor use, new fixture installation, retrofit installation, smart grid control systems, and integration of LED technology into custom applications.
